props.label: Krystal's note
props.text: Annie and Bill both have to sign, and the second signer sees where the money really goes. Annie wants a complete checklist; Bill fears a regulator more than a liar.

props.label: Annie's laminated Operations checklist
props.text: Every Operations request needs the registry vendor, an invoice number, the amount, a PLUM ticket, and who asked. Complete ones are processed the same day (Annie Uity, Nov 13).

props.label: Ledgerline bank migration memo
props.text: Ledgerline Payroll is moving banks this month. Client services will phone in the new payment details (Annie Uity, Nov 10).

props.label: Bill's audit prep binder
props.text: Brightline Audit Partners start fieldwork this month. Findings come to Bill first and stay inside Compliance (Bill Ledger, Nov 3).

props.label: Vendor registry — Ledgerline Payroll
props.text: Ledgerline Payroll is paid from Operations, and invoices start with LL-. A Nov 10 note says the new payment details arrive by phone.
